title: Extracted Excel Inputs
description: Schema describing the offsite/DPPA extracted-input layer (*_extracted_inputs.json). Only `loads_kw` is required; every other property is optional and validated for type and length only when present, because the five tracked files are deliberately heterogeneous (DEC-005).

project.description: Project name identifier; consumed by report builders and the offsite settlement path.

site.description: Site geographic and tariff metadata; required by the PVWatts generation path (latitude/longitude) and tariff resolution.

loads_kw.description: 8760-hour site load profile in kW (the only required field).

generation_kw.description: Optional 8760-hour generation profile in kW; when present it takes precedence over the PVWatts and synthetic paths in the generic orchestrator.

load_cleaning.description: Summary of load cleaning / validation steps applied; optional metadata only.

benchmark.description: Benchmark tariff and load summary metrics; required by the market-proxy and settlement paths when present.

pv_production_factor.description: PV production factor (fraction of rated capacity per hour) or site-specific scaling factor.

fmp_vnd_per_mwh.description: 8760-hour Forward Market Price series in VND/MWh (or VND/kWh per normalization).

evn_tariff.description: EVN tariff parameters for the project; required by the settlement and market-proxy paths when present.

tou_energy_rates_usd_per_kwh.description: Hourly TOU energy rates in USD/kWh. Not exact-8760: the settlement engine pads/truncates to 8760, and some tracked files carry 8784 (leap-year) series.

tou_energy_rates_vnd_per_kwh.description: Hourly TOU energy rates in VND/kWh (the settlement and market-proxy paths consume this when the USD series is absent).
